title: Camera firmware versions MV 5.5 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Mon, 11 Dec 2023

New: Insufficient Power Detection support and Red LED state on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
Performance improvement for MT Sensor connection
Bug fixes: Resolved an issue where MV Sense on MV63(x)/MV93(x) does not send a complete payload to MQTT brokers for raw_detections
Resolved an issue leading to RTSP failures with specific VMS systems on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
Resolved an issue where MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x) are not streaming audio to the Meraki Android app
Resolved an issue with historical playback on iOS and Safari
General: Improved performance for RTSP streaming on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
Improved Video Recording Stability on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
Improved accuracy of vehicle and person detection

html:
Camera firmware versions MV 5.5 changelog

New

  • Insufficient Power Detection support and Red LED state on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
  • Performance improvement for MT Sensor connection

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue where MV Sense on MV63(x)/MV93(x) does not send a complete payload to MQTT brokers for raw_detections
  • Resolved an issue leading to RTSP failures with specific VMS systems on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
  • Resolved an issue where MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x) are not streaming audio to the Meraki Android app
  • Resolved an issue with historical playback on iOS and Safari

General

  • Improved performance for RTSP streaming on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
  • Improved Video Recording Stability on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
  • Improved accuracy of vehicle and person detection
  • General stability and performance improvements
